channel.title: AKA Motions Blog
channel.description: Guides, behind-the-scenes stories and ideas on festival, event and brand video production.

item.title: How to plan a festival aftermovie that people actually rewatch
item.description: An aftermovie is next year's ticket campaign. Here's how organisers can brief, schedule and set up a shoot so the film captures the night the way it felt.

item.title: How much does event videography cost? What actually affects the price
item.description: There's no single price for event videography. Here are the factors that shape a quote, so you can compare offers fairly and brief your videographer properly.

item.title: Brand film vs commercial: which one does your business need?
item.description: They're both video, but they solve different problems. A quick guide to choosing between a brand film and a commercial, and briefing each one well.

item.title: What goes into a 60-second highlight reel delivered in 48 hours
item.description: The night ends, the crowd goes home, and the clock starts. Here's what happens between the last song and a 60-second highlight reel two days later.

item.title: Why anamorphic lenses make video look so cinematic
item.description: Wide frames, stretched flares and soft oval highlights. Here's what anamorphic lenses actually do, and when they're the right choice for your project.

item.title: 8 questions to ask before hiring a videographer
item.description: Before you book anyone, ask these eight questions. They'll tell you whether a videographer is the right fit, and save you from surprises later.

item.title: Introducing the AKA Motions blog
item.description: Guides for event organisers and brands, behind-the-scenes stories from our shoots, and the craft behind the films. Here's what to expect.
